Subject: Trial implementation railmap & toolcall schedule

Thanks for taking the time on today's call — good alignment overall. Quick recap and next steps so we all have the same plan:

High-level success criteria (as discussed)
- 95% accuracy on entity extraction for pilot (sample of 5k records)
- End-to-end 99th pct latency < 350ms for single-turn inference on dev dataset
- No sensitive PII persisted in Redwood-hosted logs (redacted at ingestion)
- Integration completed and validated by Clerity engs within the 30-day trial window

PoC scope and evaluation plan
- Week 0 (this week): sync on tech reqs & SOW (attached stub: tech-reqs.xlsx)
- Week 1: initial integration (SDK + API routes) and streaming smoke test
- Week 2: run evaluation corpus (5k records) + instrument latency/cost metrics
- Week 3: remediation and handoff for pilot ramp decision

Ownership
- Clerity: Daniel Park (technical POC), Sheila (data ops)
- Redwood: Ben Carter (deal owner), Aditya Rao (solutions/implementation), Marissa Cole (CS lead)

Open items / asks for Clerity
1) Confirm the dataset owner for the 5k eval set (format + S3 link)
2) Confirm whether you need streaming token-by-token vs. batched token output for downstream processing
3) Share a contact for infra (SSO/KMS questions)

Proposed tool-call (30-45m): Wed 1/18 or Thu 1/19 (US PST morning). During that call we'll
- walk SDK routing and example calls (streaming and non-streaming)
- confirm model variant and quantization profile for the trial
- go over pre-call checklist (SSO/KMS, firewall rules, sample payload)

Attachments: tech-reqs.xlsx (stub), ma-signed-sow.pdf (signed SOW stub)

Thanks — Ben
--

Thanks Ben — that frame looks good. A few clarifications from our side:
- Success criteria: we'll add an internal quality gate for false positive rate (target < 4%) and share evaluation labels by Friday.
- Streaming vs batch: preference is streaming for our pipeline (low latency consumer), but we may fall back to small batch windows (100–200 records) if streaming complicates the proof. Can you confirm Redwood's streaming API guarantees for partial tokens vs final tokens?
- Infra contact: looping in Priya <priya@cleritytech.com> for KMS/SSO questions.

Also: we have a security questionnaire that our procurement team expects before kickoff — I'll send it separately tonight.

Internal: putting together the implementation railmap and owner checklist ahead of the tool-call. Action items for us before Wed 1/18:
- Aditya: draft SDK routing doc (examples: streaming ws, streaming http-chunked, batch POST) + example payloads and small python nodejs snippets. Will include recommended default batch size and KV-cache hints.
- Marissa: prepare acceptance checklist and telemetry dashboards we'll hand over (latency, token cost, failures, quality sampling).
- Ben: confirm the final model variant (we suggested rdx-large-quant as baseline) and update SOW attachment if needed.

Technical notes / answers to questions
- Streaming semantics: Redwood streaming returns token deltas and finalization events. We'll provide both incremental deltas for low-latency streaming and a final event with full structured response so Clerity's pipeline can consume either.
- Security questionnaire: we'll appoint a point on our security team after we receive the questionnaire PDF.

I'll have the SDK doc draft in your inbox by EOD Monday (1/16).

Thanks — Aditya
